1932, November
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 74 Cont.
Nov. 15 Richard Manion .... most happy death Nov. 15th. Proposed questions few days before
Page 75 .. The boy (7) had asked his aunt "Aunte I know all my aspirations
. ."Now Auntie don't you think I'd have a good chance for Heaven?"
"I don't think I am bad enough for hell ... maybe for purgatory tho"
Page 76
Nov. 22 Mrs. M. Markey - 71 - 2003 Camble Ave. - cancer of Stomach "dying in Providence last April" ..... Still living & quite improved - prayers .... for complete ....
David McInerney - 15 .. . epileptic .. . . . .
Dorothy Fisher - 11 - of Port Huron - Asthma - bronchitis, etc.
Mrs. Mary Mouton - 56 - cataracts fears operation.
Rose Storey - 38 - nurse, cancer of throat operation
Frances R .... T. B. in Los Angeles - has 2 daughters. ...
Theresia Dubusschere - 86 - Very sick - wants to die .. . Regrets want of unity in her children.
Nov. 28
A. Allen - 61 - broken apendix & gangreenous - Step-Father of six, two adopted & wife & mother 70 all solicituous .... Last evening 7 min- utes after 6 was inscribed in S.M.A. at time hopeless .... This a.m. improved very surprisingly ... still in danger Adrian Allen - Operation Nov. 28 - 2:30 p.m. quite improved after prayers yesterday.
Mrs. Frances Lang - 38 - going to Kiefer Hosp. with T. B. asks pray- ers ....
Poor Lady Mrs. Gale - non C. - looking for witness for her property J. McMahon - 29 - cab-driver - terrible head-aches Blank Page
1932, December
Page 77 Page 78 Dec. Jos. Cannon - 12 - of Muskegon Euing - tumor - cancerous Elizabeth C. Higgins - 12 - Adrian, Epileptic - ten
